question: Which part of your body do you use to kick a football? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! In games like football, we use our feet to kick, pass, and shoot the ball! ⚽
hint: This body part goes inside your shoe.

question: What is the action of stopping a rolling ball called? 🛑
explanation: Great job! Stopping and controlling a ball so you can use it next is called receiving or trapping! 🛑
hint: It means to accept or catch something.

question: Where should your eyes look right before kicking the ball? 👀
explanation: Super! Looking right at the ball helps your foot hit it perfectly! 👀
hint: Look at the object you want to move.

question: Which part of your shoe is best for a very strong kick? 👟
explanation: Fantastic! Using the top of your foot where the shoelaces are gives the kick super power! 💥
hint: You tie these to keep your shoes on.

question: To trap a rolling ball safely, you can use the...? 🛑
explanation: Awesome! Stepping lightly on the ball with the bottom of your foot stops it right in place! 🛑
hint: The part of your foot that touches the ground.

question: When passing to a friend, how should you kick? 🤝
explanation: Great job! A gentle, straight pass is super easy for your friend to receive! 🤝
hint: You want it to be easy for them to catch.

question: What skill helps you look at the ball and kick it correctly? 👁️
explanation: Super! Foot-eye coordination is when your eyes and your feet work perfectly together! 👁️
hint: It connects what you see to your kick.

question: What is the best way to receive a fast rolling ball? 💨
explanation: Fantastic! Using a soft touch takes the speed away so the ball stays close to you! 🪶

question: Which outdoor game uses kicking and receiving the most? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! Football (or soccer) is all about kicking, passing, and receiving with your feet! ⚽
hint: You score goals in a net.

question: What do your arms do when you kick the ball? 🤸
explanation: Great job! Putting your arms out helps you stay steady on one foot while you kick! ⚖️
hint: They keep you from falling over.

question: What do we call kicking the ball into the net to score? 🥅
explanation: Super! Shooting is when you try to kick the ball past the goalie to score a point! 🥅

question: To make the ball go a short distance, use the...? 📏
explanation: Fantastic! The inside of your foot is like a flat paddle, perfect for short, accurate passes! 🦶
hint: The flat part on the side of your foot.

question: When receiving the ball, your foot should act like a...? 🧽
explanation: Awesome! A soft foot absorbs the ball's speed, acting just like a fluffy cushion! 🧽

question: What is the foot resting next to the ball called? 🧍
explanation: Great job! Your plant foot stays flat on the ground to give you a strong base for your kick! 🌱
hint: It sounds like a green growing thing.

question: Where should your plant foot point? 🎯
explanation: Super! Pointing your plant foot at the target helps the ball go exactly where you want! 🎯
hint: Where do you want the ball to go?

question: What do you call moving the ball forward with tiny kicks? 🏃
explanation: Fantastic! Dribbling is keeping the ball close to your feet while you run! 🏃
hint: Like bouncing in basketball, but with feet.

question: If the ball is rolling to your right, which foot stops it best? ➡️
explanation: Awesome! Using the foot closest to the ball makes receiving very easy and quick! ➡️

question: What shape should your foot make to pass the ball gently? 📐
explanation: Great job! Using the flat inside of your foot acts like a wall to push the ball straight! 🧱

question: Before kicking, what should you do first? 🤔
explanation: Super! Always look up to see where your teammates are before making a pass! 👀
hint: Use your eyes to check the field.

question: To kick the ball high in the air, where do you kick it? ☁️
explanation: Fantastic! Getting your foot underneath the bottom of the ball lifts it high into the sky! ☁️

question: To keep the ball rolling on the ground, where do you kick it? 🟢
explanation: Awesome! Kicking right in the middle keeps the ball rolling smoothly on the grass! 🟢

question: What happens if you kick the ball hard with your pointy toes? 🦶
explanation: Great job! A toe-kick is hard to control and might hurt your toes, so use the side or laces! 🔀
hint: It is very hard to control.

question: Which part of the foot gives you the most accurate pass? 🎯
explanation: Super! The flat inside of your foot is the best tool for an accurate, perfect pass! 🎯

question: What should you wear to protect your feet while kicking? 👟
explanation: Fantastic! Sports shoes protect your toes and help you kick the ball comfortably! 👟

question: When you trap the ball properly, the ball should...? 🛑
explanation: Awesome! Trapping means making the ball stop so it is ready for your next move! 🛑
hint: It stays right next to you.

question: What makes receiving a pass much easier? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Keeping your eyes on the rolling ball helps you know exactly when to trap it! 👀

question: If your friend is far away, how should you pass? 📏
explanation: Super! You need more power and a stronger kick to make the ball travel a long distance! 💥

question: What follows the ball after you kick it? 🦵
explanation: Fantastic! Letting your leg swing forward after the kick gives it power and good direction! 🦵

question: To stop a gently bouncing ball, you can use your foot or...? 🦵
explanation: Awesome! If the ball bounces up, you can use your thigh or knee to gently bump it down! 🦵
hint: The bendy part of your leg.

question: What do we call kicking the ball back and forth with a friend? 🔄
explanation: Great job! Passing back and forth is the best way to practice kicking and receiving! ⚽

question: How do you feel when your team scores a great goal? 🥅
explanation: Super! Scoring a goal is a fun and exciting reward for playing well together! 😄

question: What is the best way to get better at kicking? 🏆
explanation: Fantastic! The more you practice touching and kicking the ball, the better you become! 🏆

question: In a football game, who is allowed to use their hands? 🧤
explanation: Awesome! The goalie gets to use their hands to block the ball from going into the net! 🧤
hint: The person standing in the net.

question: When dribbling, where should the ball stay? 🏃
explanation: Great job! Keeping the ball close helps you control it so no one else can take it! 🦶

question: What do you say when you want a pass from a friend? 🗣️
explanation: Super! Calling out 'I am open!' lets your teammate know you are ready to receive the ball! 🙋
hint: Let them know you are ready.

question: What happens when you kick the ball with your heel? 👞
explanation: Fantastic! A cool trick is using your heel to pass the ball backwards to a teammate! 🔙

question: What is a fun and safe target to aim for when practicing? 🎯
explanation: Awesome! Plastic cones make perfect, safe targets to practice your kicking accuracy! 🚥

question: What do we call stopping a pass meant for the other team? 🛑
explanation: Great job! Stepping in to receive the ball before the other team gets it is called intercepting! ✋

question: To kick the ball very hard, you need a good...? 🏃
explanation: Super! Taking a few running steps before you kick gives your foot a lot more power! 🏃

question: When receiving the ball, you should slightly bend your...? 🦵
explanation: Fantastic! Bending your knees helps you balance and gives you a softer touch on the ball! 🦵

question: What helps you stay balanced while standing on one foot to kick? ⚖️
explanation: Awesome! Holding your arms out like airplane wings helps keep your body perfectly balanced! 👐

question: What should you do after your team scores a goal? 🎉
explanation: Great job! Cheering and high-fiving your teammates makes the game fun for everyone! 🙌

question: What happens if you step hard on top of the ball while running? 🛑
explanation: Super! The ball rolls, so stepping on top of it while moving fast can make you slip! Be careful! 🤕

question: Which kicking skill do you use to start a football game? ⚽
explanation: Fantastic! A kick-off from the middle of the field begins the fun football match! ⚽

question: What kind of ball is best and safest for kicking practice? ⚽
explanation: Awesome! A proper, soft football is safe for your feet and rolls perfectly on the grass! ⚽

question: How do you pass to someone standing right next to you? 🧍
explanation: Great job! A gentle tap with the side of your foot is perfect for a very short pass! 🦶

question: When trapping, if your foot is too stiff and hard, the ball will...? 🪀
explanation: Super! If your foot is hard like a brick, the ball will bounce away. Keep your foot soft! 🪀
hint: It acts like a bouncy wall.

question: Playing safely and nicely with your friends means following the...? 📜
explanation: Fantastic! Following the rules keeps the game fair, safe, and super fun for everybody! 📏

question: What is the area called where you kick the ball to score a point? 🥅
explanation: Awesome! Kicking the ball past the goal line into the net earns your team a point! 🥅

question: Why is it important to practice both kicking and receiving? ⚖️
explanation: Great job! A great player knows how to send the ball (kicking) and catch the ball (receiving)! ⚖️
